name: Catch and read
blurb: The first read after a catch: look up, see who's open, and move the ball before the defense recovers.

JP-PG.t: Learn Point Guard Reads from an NBA Player (Live Mic'd Up)

JP-YF.t: How NBA Players See The Game (I Break Down YOUR Film)

m.title: Outlet up the floor
m.q: You have the ball. Pass to your teammate now or hold it?
m.ans: Pass. #42 has his back to you, so he can't see the pass coming.
m.quote: If a defender's back is facing you, throw the ball. They are wide open… number 42 isn't looking at me.

m.title: Outlet up the floor, second look
m.q: Same idea, different look. Pass or hold?
m.ans: Pass. The defender in the white shirt turns his back, so he can't see the pass to his man.
m.quote: White shirt turns his back. He can't see that I'm throwing the ball at his man.

m.title: Teammate with a defender on him
m.q: Your teammate has a defender right next to him. Is he open?
m.ans: Yes. The defender is right next to him but can't make a play on the ball, so he's open.
m.quote: Even though it doesn't look like he's open, he's open cuz the defender can't make a play on the ball.

m.title: The outlet catch
m.q: You just caught the outlet. What's your first move?

choices.t: Put it on the floor and push
Look up the floor before you dribble

m.ans: Look up before you dribble. #24 isn't looking at you, so you can advance it to his man.
m.quote: You should never catch it, dribble. The first thing you should do is catch and look… Number 24 is not looking at me. I can advance to him.
cast: YOU · Preston, just caught the outlet

m.title: Big rolling to the rim
m.q: Your big is rolling. Throw it to him?
m.ans: No. The low man is coming to help and your big can't see him. Preston jumps and passes opposite, away from where the defender's weight just moved.

m.title: Coming off the ball screen
m.q: Coming off the screen, read the defense. Where does the ball go?
m.ans: Skip it to the corner. His defender throws his hands up and the low man creeps in, so he looks at the roller and skips it to the corner.

m.title: Screener's defender at the ball screen
m.q: You come off the screen. What's the play?

choices.t: Hit the shooter next to you

m.ans: Hit the shooter right next to you. The screener's defender hedges for a second, so that's the easy play.
m.quote: I see that he hedges for a second. I got a shooter right next to me… It's an easy play.

m.title: Catch with a little space
m.q: You catch it with a little space. Shoot right away?

choices.t: Yes, shoot it on the catch
No, take a second and read it

m.ans: Take a second first. Preston told his teammate he had a dribble into a layup, or the corner.
m.quote: You caught it and shot it. Just give yourself more time. You had dribble lay. You had corner.
cast: YOU · the teammate who catches it

m.title: Big running the floor
m.q: Your big is running the floor ahead of you. Throw it now or wait?
m.ans: Wait a beat, until he's close enough to finish without dribbling.
m.quote: I don't want to put my big in a position to give him the ball here… wait for him to go a little bit closer to the rim.

m.title: Catch on the wing
m.q: You catch on the wing. What's the play?

choices.t: Hold it and call for a screen

m.ans: Look first. He reads the helper and swings it to the corner right away.
m.quote: Catches it. First thing he does is look… Makes the read of this guy. Immediately swings to the corner.
cast: YOU · on the wing, the ball on its way

m.title: Driving into the paint
m.q: You've driven into the paint. Go up or pass?
m.ans: Pass. He drew four defenders, so a teammate has an open layup or an open three.
m.quote: So glad he passed this ball… he drew four… he made the right read. Open layup or open three any day of the week.

m.title: Before the catch
m.q: The ball is on its way to you. What's your first move?
m.ans: Pass on the catch. A dribble gives his defender time to recover. Know your next move before the ball gets to you.
m.quote: You taking this dribble could allow him to recover… Even before receiving the ball, we should kind of already know what we're about to be doing.
